content_sections.heading: ACTREC Post Doctoral Fellow at a Glance

rows.details: Advanced Centre for Treatment, Research and Education in Cancer (ACTREC) / Tata Memorial Centre
Developing cancer therapeutics to target the anti-apoptotic cFLIP-CaM interaction and restore tumor cells sensitivity to death ligands
Six months (may be extended based on monitored work progress)

content_sections.heading: Who Can Apply
content_sections.text: Candidates must possess a Ph.D. Degree in life sciences and allied fields to be eligible for the Post Doctoral Fellow position. Desirable Qualification: Experience in cell-based assays, recombinant protein expression and purification, molecular biology, biophysics, and biochemistry is required. Prior experience with techniques such as gene cloning, subcloning, site-directed mutagenesis, plasmid isolation, MTT, flow cytometry (FACS), Western blotting, co-immunoprecipitation, and other apoptosis-related assays, along with the ability to work independently in a research laboratory, will be preferred.

content_sections.heading: Pay and Tenure
content_sections.text: The selected candidate will receive a consolidated salary of Rs. 73,660/- p.m. The appointment duration is six months, during which the work progress of candidates will be monitored, and the contract may be extended accordingly.

content_sections.heading: How to Apply for ACTREC Post Doctoral Fellow
content_sections.text: Prepare your CV, educational documents, and Aadhaar card soft copy in PDF format. Draft a cover letter supporting your candidature for the applied post. Write a 300-word write-up on why you find this project interesting and its future possible applications. Send all required documents in PDF format via email to [email protected] by the last date of application.

content_sections.heading: Selection and Interview
content_sections.text: Only the short-listed candidates will be contacted by email and notified about the interview date and timings. The interview will be conducted in hybrid mode, giving shortlisted candidates the option to confirm whether they will attend in person or online, although an in-person interview for local candidates will be preferred.

faq.question: Q1. Is the Post Doctoral Fellow post permanent or on contract?
faq.answer: The position is on a project basis with a tenure of six months, which may be extended based on monitored work progress.

faq.question: Q2. What are the desirable qualifications for this project position?
faq.answer: Experience in cell-based assays, recombinant protein expression and purification, molecular biology, biophysics, and biochemistry is required.

faq.question: Q3. How will candidates be shortlisted and interviewed?
faq.answer: Candidates will be short-listed and contacted by email with interview details, which will be held in hybrid mode allowing for either in-person or online attendance.

faq.question: Q4. Which documents must be attached with the email application?
faq.answer: Applicants must send their CV, educational documents, Aadhaar card soft copy in PDF format, a cover letter, and a 300-word write-up.
